expr: (() => { const tiles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).filter(a => a.getAttribute('href') && a.getAttribute('href').startsWith('/tools/')).map(a => ({ label: a.textContent.trim(), href: a.getAttribute('href') })); return { path: location.pathname, tileCount: tiles.length, tiles, hasKeycloak: document.body.innerText.includes('Keycloak'), hasLoki: document.body.innerText.includes('Loki'), hasGrafana: document.body.innerText.includes('Grafana'), hasOpenWebUI: document.body.innerText.includes('Open WebUI'), hasLangflow: document.body.innerText.includes('Langflow'), hasCoolify: document.body.innerText.includes('Coolify') }; })()
